name: Port Clinton (United States)
description: White field with two wavy red stripes along the bottom for Lake Erie and a red anchor in the upper hoist.
history: Port Clinton is a city in and the county seat of Ottawa County, Ohio, located at the mouth of the Portage River on Lake Erie. The flag was adopted in 2020 (designed by resident Ben Lucas and announced as the winner of a city flag contest at the council meeting of 8 December 2020, according to Flags of the World citing The Beacon).

features.role: two wavy stripes for Lake Erie
